detector.note: Optional local YOLO segmentation weights ONLY. No models, datasets or real images are downloaded automatically. Generic COCO weights do not provide a dedicated bangus class. Default contour fallback is not species recognition.

reference.note: Physical square size MUST be supplied/verified by the operator. Board has 8 x 6 squares. No scale is inferred without detection.

measurement.note: ASSUMPTION: thresholds for a flat, plain, light background. Classical contours are fish candidates, not species recognition. Fork landmarks require manual review.

length_weight.source: Bagarinao & Thayaparan (1986), Aquaculture 55:241-246. 31 wild juveniles, Sri Lanka, fork length 92-186 mm. Published log10(W_g) = -5.6083 + 3.2598*log10(L_mm). Converted to cm: a=10**(-5.6083+3.2598).
length_weight.note: Published relation, NOT calibrated for Hayuma Cooperative. Do not extrapolate beyond source length range. Refit only on separate training measurements; never on evaluation images.

age.note: Range is a sensitivity envelope with a PLACEHOLDER +/-25% weight tolerance and minimum +/-14 days; not a calibrated confidence interval. Existing growth model is synthetic. Days are since stocking, not birth.

video.note: ASSUMPTION: conservative position/size assignment tracker. Distinct tracks are not a verified stock count. Occlusions, crossings and re-entry can split or merge tracks.
